SLG59M301V                                                                                 

An Ultra-small 3 mm2, 8.5 mΩ, 4 A,
Internally-protected Load Switch

General Description                                                  Pin Configuration
The SLG59M301V is a high performance 8.5 mΩ, 4 A
single-channel nFET load switch which can operate with a
2.5 V to 5.5 V VDD supply to switch power rails from as low as
0.85 V up to the supply voltage. The SLG59M301V                                      VDD     1                  8     GND




                                                                                                   SLG59M301V
incorporates two-level overload current protection, thermal
shutdown protection, and inrush current control which can                            ON      2                  7     CAP
easily be adjusted by a small external capacitor.
                                                                                      D      3                  6     S
Using a proprietary MOSFET design, the SLG59M301V
achieves a stable 8.5 mΩ RDSON across a wide input voltage                            D       4                 5     S
range. In addition, the SLG59M301V’s package also exhibits
low thermal resistance for high-current operation using
Renesas’s advanced assembly technology.                                                8-pin FC-TDFN
Fully specified over the -40 °C to 85 °C temperature range, the                          (Top View)
SLG59M301V is packaged in a space-efficient, low thermal
resistance, RoHS-compliant 1.5 mm x 2.0 mm STDFN
package.                                                             Applications
Features                                                              • Notebook Power Rail Switching
                                                                      • Tablet Power Rail Switching
Internally-protected Load Switch
